text: {"decision": "reject", "reason": "users.UpVotes is a per-user vote counter whose small integer values (mostly 0–4, max 11442) coincidentally fall inside the dense 1–386848 range of the postHistory.Id surrogate primary key, so the 95.5% containment is chance overlap with no semantic reference (coverage is only 0.001 and the natural key users.Id → postHistory.UserId exists separately)."}
